items.quote: He contributed effectively to teamwork across departments on the annual review.
Peers observed that Liovi Wildovan led an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations across the department.
Several respondents noted that Liovi Wildovan led capability building for new hires across the department.
Peers observed that Liovi Wildovan led dashboards tracking service performance metrics across the department.
Direct reports said that Liovi headed service-level targets for frontline operations, setting priorities for several teams.
Several respondents noted that Liovi Wildovan headed media interviews and press conferences, setting priorities for several teams.
He championed the migration of core services to the cloud and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Liovi led a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading across the department.
He led the organisational restructuring of the department across the department.
